parameters.name: mig_hosts
parameters.help: Specify the name of host(s) for the migration server(s).

parameters.name: n_cpu
parameters.help: Enter the number of nodes to use as migration servers

parameters.name: mig_type
parameters.help: Select Phase Shift or Stolt migration

parameters.name: demig
parameters.help: Select Migrate, Demigrate or Inverse Migrate.

parameters.name: dodips
parameters.help: You can migrate dips up to and/or beyond 90 degrees.

parameters.name: stolt_stretch
parameters.help: Range 0 < factor < 2.  Use 1.0 for constant velocity, 0.6 for gradual velocity increase with depth typical of young, uncompacted sediments.

parameters.name: stolt_obliq
parameters.help: Set this to 'No' ONLY if you plan to do a Stolt demigration on the data later.

parameters.name: max_angle
parameters.help: Enter angle in degrees. Range 0 < angle < 90. High-dip taper reduces amplitude of dipping linear artifacts created by inverse migration.

parameters.name: vel_file
parameters.help: Select an Interval Velocity in Time file from the menu.

parameters.name: min_xline_no
parameters.help: Minimum CDP bin number of image aperture.

parameters.name: max_xline_no
parameters.help: Maximum CDP bin number of image aperture.

parameters.name: dcdp
parameters.help: CDP spacing in ft or meters (consistent with headers).

parameters.name: max_tau
parameters.help: Enter the trace length in ms for output (de)migrated data. 0.0 means use input trace length.

parameters.name: dtau
parameters.help: Enter the sampling interval in ms for output (de)migrated data. 0.0 means use input sampling interval.

parameters.name: min_frequency
parameters.help: Minimum frequency to (de)migrate, in Hz.

parameters.name: max_frequency
parameters.help: Maximum frequency to (de)migrate, in Hz. This value has a strong impact on run time. 0.0 means go to 0.6*Nyquist.

parameters.name: n_xline_pad
parameters.help: Enter the padding to avoid spatial wrap around.

parameters.name: changeTapering
parameters.help: Tapering is automatically applied to the bottom and edges of the data.  Enter YES to change the amount of tapering.

parameters.name: ms_taper
parameters.help: The bottom of all traces is tapered to avoid data truncation artifacts.

parameters.name: taperTop
parameters.help: Edge taper varies linearly between upper and lower parts of section.

parameters.name: taperBot
parameters.help: Edge taper varies linearly between upper and lower parts of section.  Edge taper is usually greater toward bottom of section.

parameters.name: remute
parameters.help: If 'Yes', input trace mutes are reapplied on output.  If 'No', no mutes are applied and mute header entries are adjusted.

parameters.name: rekill
parameters.help: Select desired type of rekill behavior: All, None or Edges only.

parameters.name: file_factor
parameters.help: Data are spread over n by n array of scratch files, where n='Number of nodes'*'File factor'. Increasing file factor may improve performance.

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.help: Scratch file names start with ID_area_line_flow_.  Code different IDs to run multiple jobs at the same time from the same flow.

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.help: 'Yes' provides extra printout on what is going on, especially in migration servers.
